name: Haruki's Magical Adventure
source:
Magical Girl Haruki needs help saving his prince, Chi-chi, from the evil bad guys trying to take him away! Follow him as he fights bad guys and spends time with his beloved and makes sure Chi-chi is safe from the ever-growing number of murders in their town!

Made by Kryouma as part of Magical Girl Game Jam 3 and then finished development under NaNoReno
translation:
魔法少女春树需要帮忙，得把他的王子奇奇从那些想把王子带走的恶棍手里救出来！跟着他一起打坏人、和心上人共度时光，确保镇上不断增加的凶杀案不会危及奇奇！

由Kryouma为第三届Magical Girl Game Jam创作，随后在NaNoRenO活动期间完成开发。
